metadata.title: Hyperbolicity Beyond Convexity in the Alexandrov-Fenchel Inequality
metadata.abstract: We establish an Alexandrov--Fenchel type inequality in which one of the reference bodies is replaced by a function whose Hessian satisfies a balancing condition on its eigenvalues, without being required to be positive semidefinite. The proof hinges on a new extension of Alexandrov's inequality for mixed discriminants. As applications, we derive a log-concavity principle for linear functionals of area measures, answering a question of Colesanti, Hug, and Saorín-Gómez, as well as Brunn--Minkowski type inequalities for intrinsic volumes of mean section bodies, answering a question of Schuster.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 超越凸性的 Alexandrov–Fenchel 不等式
analysis.workSummary: 以 Hessian 特征值 balancing 条件替代一个 reference body 的正半定要求，扩展 mixed discriminant 不等式；推出 area measure linear functional 的 log-concavity 及 mean section body 的 Brunn–Minkowski 型不等式。
analysis.breakthrough: 放宽经典 AF 框架的凸性并回答两个既有问题。
analysis.limitations: Hessian 虽可不正半定，仍须满足特定 balancing 条件。
